body:
I am an experienced opiate user, around 5 years. I favor oral ROA and drugs like oxycodone and fentanyl patches.
Last night, I dosed (parachuted) 25mg acetyl fentanyl, weighed up in micrograms on accurate digital scales. I also ingested at the same time; 20mgs of new formula oxycodone, about a gram of pot and 100mg of promethazine.
Two hours and a few bongs later, I was nodding hard. Euphoric, warm nods. There's not a lot of information available regarding recommended dosages of acetyl fentanyl, and I tested the waters a lot before I worked my way up to 25mg. With my first few very low solo doses being almost non-effective. This combination was the most enjoyable experience I've had on acetyl thus far. I don't recommend you start dosing 25mg, that would be extremely foolish.
I trust my source, my product wasn't cut. Acetyl might not be as potent as many make it out to be, still, as with any untested substance there might be an array of unknown side effects, some which may be specific to the individual. Considering the lack of information on acetyl, I thought I'd share my experience, hopefully I've given enough information to give people a little insight into this substance's potential.
